description: Use of Chronic Disease Management and Allied Health Medicare Services is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW). The Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW) publishes data on use of Medicare chronic disease management (CDM) services and Medicare-subsidised allied health services as an interactive web report and downloadable data tables (Excel format). For 2019, GP Management Plan and Team Care Arrangement service usage rates are available for Primary Health Networks (PHNs) and Statistical Area Level 3s (SAs). Coverage is Australia, 2010 to 2020; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as non-current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-21. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
